candidates.name: The Villages
candidates.summary: A vast 55+ master-planned community built around golf-cart mobility, recreation, healthcare access, town squares and an unusually dense social calendar.

candidates.name: Sofia
candidates.summary: A high-elevation European capital combining metro-connected urban life, Roman and Orthodox heritage, comparatively moderate costs and immediate access to Vitosha Mountain.

candidates.name: Puerto Vallarta
candidates.summary: A Pacific coast city where a walkable historic center, beaches, strong dining, established expat networks and direct North American air service meet tropical weather.

candidates.name: Hoi An
candidates.summary: A compact UNESCO-listed trading-port city with exceptional walkability in the historic core, low everyday costs, beach access and a strong café-and-food culture.

candidates.name: Queenstown
candidates.summary: A spectacular Southern Alps lake town with world-class outdoor recreation, strong tourism infrastructure, excellent safety and a severe housing-cost premium.

candidates.name: Ascoli Piceno
candidates.summary: Elegant travertine city in southern Marche combining a walkable historic center, food culture and Apennine access.

candidates.name: Sarandë
candidates.summary: Ionian coastal city with a long promenade, seasonal international energy and comparatively moderate living costs.

candidates.name: Dumaguete City
candidates.summary: English-usable university city with a strong retiree community, regional healthcare and attractive Philippine living costs.

candidates.name: Las Terrenas
candidates.summary: International Caribbean beach town with multiple residential zones, foreign ownership rights and pensioner residence paths.

candidates.name: Fairhope
candidates.summary: Polished Mobile Bay community with a walkable downtown, golf, parks, arts and a full-service local hospital.
